verdict.rationale: Publishing a customer-facing changelog is a fair capability to ask of a product-management tool, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a changelog, release notes, or any way to publish shipped-feature announcements to customers. The "close the loop" marketing line refers to linking specs, shipped work, and outcomes internally, not to customer announcements, and release, webhook, and API primitives are only building blocks.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can publish a changelog announcing shipped features to close the loop with customers
